title: About
subtitle: AI-Assisted Development
description:
Sandbox is an experimental environment. This site enables the exploration and implementation of various ideas and techniques stemming from an artificial-intelligence-assisted development approach. The project relies on a collaborative and communicative approach between a developer and artificial intelligence models.

Methodological principles:
Technical co-construction: Integrating AI as a development tool and active assistant in bringing projects to fruition.

Iterative process: Continuous exchanges and communications shaping the evolution of code and features.

Pursuit of originality: Leveraging interactions with AI to move beyond predetermined structures and generate singular, initially unplanned results.

Sandbox thus formalizes a space for study and practice centered on the dynamics of machine-augmented programming.
